name: tau-reasoning
description: Picks each message's reasoning effort on auto

redecide.description: Jev looks again when a step's effort runs out, not only as each message comes in. Each change resends the whole context uncached, so it pays only on long tool chains.
redecide.title: Decide again between steps

threshold.description: Below it, a message runs at the effort the last one ran at.
threshold.title: Confidence to change the effort

picker_auto.jev: Auto lets tau-reasoning pick the effort for each message, with Jev.
picker_auto.no_jev: Auto leaves the effort to the model: tau-reasoning needs a TypeSafe key (Models).
